sequence.executionClaim: BDD specification mapped to built-in Node tests and actual browser checks; no Cucumber execution is claimed.

sequence.stage: Loadable stub and genuine behavioral RED
sequence.failure: ERR_ASSERTION: expected success, actual unknown, after existing createLesson/step methods loaded.

sequence.stage: IaC applicability after RED and before implementation
sequence.reason: Resource-free local lesson; no infrastructure, identity, deployment or spending authorized.

sequence.behavior: Guarded before/after worker-affinity comparison; two fixed clients and workers; exact state receipts; immutable views; 16-step bound; separate hypothetical counterexample; retained negative evidence; keyboard/error/reset UX.

sequence.scope: Deterministic model and static surface; not DOM/browser proof.

retainedAttempts.qualification: First UI run passed eight cases but privileged DevTools eval was an invalid CSP test context; the failed attempt remains failed. The qualifying run uses an allowed external author script without weakening CSP or shared tooling.

rawProvenance.encoding: Original stdout/stderr bytes retained as base64 with SHA-256 and length in .raw.json files.
rawProvenance.readableNormalization: Only CRLF and trailing line whitespace are normalized in readable .txt logs; original raw bytes remain unchanged.

ordinaryVerification.guard: Without CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1, every owned file hash is compared before/after the browser run.
ordinaryVerification.intentionalCaptureOnly: CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 creates a new numbered observation; it never replaces prior browser proof or automatically selects a new record.

verifierResult: Synthetic positive, explicit negative and unknown cases verified; no native/live result.

userImpactResult.supportedAfterMigration: 4/4 synthetic requests preserve both clients across both workers.
userImpactResult.unsupportedBeforeMigration: Explicit failure and safe abort before exposure; affinity stays on and no session resets.
userImpactResult.unsafeCounterexample: 2/4 HTTP 200 responses lack required state; hypothetical interruption, NOT APPLIED.
userImpactResult.unknown: Missing response/receipt remains unknown, never successful continuity.

cleanupResult: Both observed browser attempts closed in awaited finally; no cloud resources were created.

refinement.nativeRemainder: B-S033 remains separately gated by CORE, DATA, ASANY and C108; full D-S033/source-parent completion is not claimed.

limits: Only local synthetic observations; no live Azure, native B-S033 or source-parent completion.
In-memory, two-client, two-worker, read-only model; no durability, races, concurrent writes, authentication or real cookies.
History lasts for at most 16 steps in this page; reset/reload deliberately clears it.
Guard and migration checks are not user-request continuity probes.
Node 22 test tooling and the approved offline Playwright 1.56.1/signed Edge 156 pairing only; no production Node 24 certification.
No cloud, IaC, identity, deployment, expenditure, package installation or extra Kano unit.
